6
An object moves at constant speed around a circular path.
Which statement is correct?
A
A resultant force acts on the object outwards from the centre of the circle.
B
A resultant force acts on the object in the direction it is travelling.
C
A resultant force acts on the object towards the centre of the circle.
D
There is no resultant force acting on the object because it is moving at constant speed.

options.label: A
options.text: A resultant force acts on the object outwards from the centre of the circle.

options.label: B
options.text: A resultant force acts on the object in the direction it is travelling.

options.label: C
options.text: A resultant force acts on the object towards the centre of the circle.

options.label: D
options.text: There is no resultant force acting on the object because it is moving at constant speed.
